## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** At `4ff92b1`, hovering the reserved drawer space still opens the tray drawer (low impact).

[Earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13121#issuecomment-5824600229):
- Resolved: settings lost on pin/hide, chevron direction, moving pins, "screen edge" wording.

### Reserved space opens the drawer on hover

The tray's `containmentMask` excludes the reserved space, but the `HoverHandler` is on the child `drawerArea` (the full drawer block), which a parent's mask does not filter. **Impact:** with three drawer icons, an 81 px zone toward the bar center opens the drawer (all four layouts). `quattro`'s forward layout does the same, but the new comment says the space passes through and the test checks only the mask.

**Suggested change:** give `drawerArea` its own `containmentMask` limited to the chevron and revealed icons (diff below).

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 4ff92b1)</summary>

# Reproducer: hovering the reserved drawer space opens the tray drawer

Reviewed head: `4ff92b11317789f9f0662eb35ba8f71e497d8b36`. Runtime used: Quickshell 0.3.1, Qt 6.11.2 (`qt6-declarative`, which also ships the QtTest QML module this test imports for `TestEvent`), `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`.

The test sends real mouse-move events into the offscreen window (QtTest `TestEvent.mouseMove`, which goes through `QQuickWindow` hover delivery like a compositor motion event). For each orientation and direction, with two pinned and three drawer items and the drawer collapsed, it moves the pointer to the middle of the unrevealed (reserved) drawer space and expects `tray.expanded` to stay `false`, then moves onto the chevron and expects `true` as a positive control. Reversed cases run first. On failure it prints only the fixture's own `FAIL:`/`Error:` lines, not Quickshell's launcher log.

Add both files, then run `bash test/shell.d/tray-reserved-hover-test.sh`.

## `test/shell.d/tray-reserved-hover-test.sh`

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail
source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"

if ! command -v quickshell >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  skip "quickshell unavailable; skipping tray reserved-space hover check"
  exit 0
fi

fixture=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$fixture"' EXIT
cp "$SHELL_TEST_DIR/fixtures/tray-reserved-hover/shell.qml" "$fixture/shell.qml"
ln -s "$ROOT/shell/Commons" "$fixture/Commons"
ln -s "$ROOT/shell/Ui" "$fixture/Ui"
ln -s "$ROOT/shell/plugins/bar/widgets" "$fixture/widgets"

# Real pointer delivery (QtTest TestEvent) into an offscreen window. On failure
# print only the fixture's own result lines, not Quickshell's launcher log.
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen timeout 30 quickshell -p "$fixture" --no-color >"$fixture/log" 2>&1 || {
  rg 'FAIL:|Error:' "$fixture/log" >&2 || true
  fail "tray reserved-space hover runtime"
}
if ! rg -q 'PASS: tray reserved space' "$fixture/log" || rg -q 'FAIL:|Error:' "$fixture/log"; then
  rg 'FAIL:|Error:' "$fixture/log" >&2 || true
  fail "hovering the unrevealed drawer space leaves the tray collapsed"
fi
pass "hovering the unrevealed drawer space leaves the tray collapsed"
```

## Suggested change

Mask the HoverHandler's own parent, `drawerArea`. Qt checks a handler against its parent item's `contains()`, and a parent's `containmentMask` does not filter delivery to its children.

+        containmentMask: QtObject {

+            if (point.y < 0 || point.y > drawerArea.height) return false
+            return root.drawerReversed
+              ? point.x >= 0 && point.x <= expandIcon.width + root.revealExtent
+              : point.x >= root.chevronOffset && point.x <= drawerArea.width

@@ -386,6 +394,14 @@
